description: This file declares the VsockFrameProvider class, which reads data from a virtual socket (vsock) for camera frame data, providing methods to start/stop data reading, request/cancel JPEG data, and copy YUV/JPEG frames. It includes external dependencies on Android graphics mapper and a VsockConnection class, and defines internal synchronization primitives and data buffers.

classes.name: VsockFrameProvider
classes.description: A class that manages reading camera frame data from a virtual socket (vsock), providing methods to start/stop data acquisition, request JPEG frames, and copy YUV/JPEG data to user buffers. It handles synchronization and threading internally.

methods.name: VsockFrameProvider
methods.description: Default constructor for the VsockFrameProvider class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the frame provider with a shared VsockConnection and expected frame dimensions, starting the data reading process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the data reading process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: requestJpeg
methods.description: Requests the provider to capture or send a JPEG frame.

methods.name: jpegPending
methods.description: Returns whether a JPEG frame is pending.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the frame provider is currently running.

methods.name: waitYUVFrame
methods.description: Waits for a YUV frame to be available, up to a maximum specified wait time.

methods.name: copyYUVFrame
methods.description: Copies the latest YUV frame data into the provided buffer if dimensions match.

methods.name: copyJpegData
methods.description: Copies the latest JPEG data into the provided buffer.
